identity.one_line: An exoskeleton tank built on Carapace regeneration, Chitin, poison retaliation, Impale, Expulsion, and Molt. It combines high self-repair with AoE poison threat. Recent community builds and discussion consistently identify it as one of the strongest-feeling current dungeon tanks, but that is observational rather than a verified ranking.
